trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Confirmed checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions with an 18% error rate. From the deployment history, the most recent version that was *healthy in production* was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc had only been in staging and was also unhealthy, so it was excluded).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**. Rollback completed successfully and was verified.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the failure and the rollback action taken.
